g.text: Impulso Morelia: Tatiana Huezo’s ‘Galerna’ Takes Top José María Riba Award, With ‘Homeboys’ Another Key Winner ◆ Bill Maher’s Embarrassing Karoline Leavitt Interview on ‘Real Time’ ◆ ‘Law & Order: SVU’ Sets Stephanie March to Return as Alexandra Cabot ◆ Ethan Klein Reacts to Hila Klein’s Cheating Allegations Amid ‘H3 Podcast’ Fallout: ‘Please Respect My Family’s Privacy … They Have Nothing to Do With This’ ◆ Blumhouse Soliciting Testimony from Anyone Who Feels ‘Personally Victimized’ by One of Its Movies or TV Shows ◆ Hunter Biden Signs With CAA ◆
